canonical_project: Datagrid Tasman Ring Network / South Island-Australia subsea fibre cable (Oreti Beach)
notes: Resource consent approved alongside Datagrid Data Park for an undersea fibre optic cable linking South Island to Australia (Tasman Ring Network per Datagrid; domestic ring Auckland-New Plymouth-Greymouth-Invercargill bypassing Wellington fault zone + Oreti Beach cable lead). Connectivity infrastructure project, approved.
